value.rationale: Complete sharp geometric minimax for the natural right regular bipyramid family, with unique equidihedral optimizer and a nontrivial fixed-normal-elevation-asymmetry threshold separating attained from unattained optima. The failure of this family to sustain near-right-angle upper bounds as n grows supplies a concrete limit to a recent general existence question. The exact linear asymmetry penalty quantifies stability, unlike routine evaluation of one dihedral angle.
